About The Graph

The Graph is a decentralized protocol for indexing and querying blockchain data. GRT is staked by indexers and used to pay for queries.

Where this GRT price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (GRT-USD), Binance (GRT/USDT) and Kraken (GRT/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 10.51B GRT (supply last updated October 30, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.
